title: The Super Bee II 28.5 V Starting Cart – 28 V DC
description: The Super Bee II is designed for all turbine and piston aircraft. 28.5 volts of pure DC starting power (no AC ripple) 25-35 starts between charges Illuminated capacity gauge 10 foot Main 4/0 heavy duty starting cable included Pneumatic tires and castors with roller bearings 12 volt cable with alligator clamps Designed for quick, cool starts every time External 28 volt charger with 11–hour timer and ammeter included
